title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not part of the divided-power de Rham notes around it. It is a typed page, numbered '- 190 -' and headed 'IX', from Grothendieck's SGA 7 I, Exposé IX ('Modèles de Néron et monodromie'), §14.1. It is misfiled in cote 136, and the archive stamp 508 confirms it comes from another sequence.

Setting: S = Spec R is a henselian or complete trait with fraction field K, and A_K is an abelian variety over K. The page concerns the rigid-analytic uniformization homomorphism e of (14.1.7), roughly e: G_K^an -> A_K^an. Its kernel is the lattice coming from the character/period data M_K.

The argument runs as follows.
1. The construction is compatible with any change of trait S' -> S. By finite descent one may therefore assume A_K has semi-stable reduction.
2. In that case T_K, G_K, B_K, M_K are generic fibres of S-group schemes T, G, B, M. Here G is an extension of the abelian scheme B by the torus T (§7). G is the 'Raynaud extension' that algebraizes the formal completion of the identity component A^o of the Néron model.
3. By construction (7.2.6) there is an isomorphism of formal groups Ĝ ≅ (A^o)^ (14.1.8). Passing to Raynaud generic fibres gives an isomorphism of rigid-analytic groups Ĝ^an ≅ (A^o)^,an (14.1.9).
4. There are open immersions Ĝ^an ↪ G_K^an and (A^o)^,an ↪ A_K^an (14.1.10). These are open subgroups (the 'bounded' parts) but in general not isomorphisms.
5. e is characterized uniquely by commutativity of the square (14.1.11). It must extend the formal isomorphism from the open subgroup Ĝ^an to all of G_K^an.

Uniqueness holds because G_K^an is connected and smooth, so a homomorphism is determined by its restriction to an admissible open subgroup. Existence is the substantive theorem (Raynaud; Mumford in the totally degenerate case). This is the standard Raynaud/Mumford/Bosch–Lütkebohmert uniformization picture A_K^an = G_K^an / M.
errors: No mathematical error is visible on this page. Uniqueness of e is asserted without argument; it follows from connectedness of G_K^an (analytic continuation from an open subgroup). Existence is not proved here and rests on Raynaud's rigid-geometry results.
Typographical errors in the typescript itself: 'ridige-analytiques', 'analytiquessur', 'dé façon'.

Uniformization homomorphism G_K^an -> A_K^an characterized by extending the formal isomorphism on the open subgroup of generic fibres

deep.surprise_reason: This is a misfiled typescript page of the published SGA 7 I, Exposé IX, §14.1, with content identical to the published text. The only point of interest is archival: a published SGA 7 page sits inside the pd de Rham dossier.
transcription_corrections: The page is a typed page of SGA 7 I, Exposé IX, p. 190, not part of the handwritten pd de Rham notes.
'ridige-analytiquessur K' is in the original typescript; it should read 'rigide-analytiques sur K'.
The second isomorphism in (14.1.8) and (14.1.9) has the hat over A^o (the completion of A^o along the special fibre), i.e. (A^o)^.
Underlined M_K is the original's notation for a group scheme (lattice); the transcription has it right.
